line_items.work_text: Three Centre of Excellence for Capacity Building on Earthquake Resistant Construction Technology • Preparation of training materials, training of graduate & diploma engineers in Earthquake resistant construction technology • Training of technical persons cluster wise through these four Centre of Excellence covering all districts . • Conducting rapid visual screening & structural vulnerability of buildings in the nearby districts by these centers. • These four centers will be developed & monitored by ASDMA in coordination with the concerned DDMA's.

Operational Expenses for VSAT Network of ASDMA Fixed mandatory annual recurring charges, usage & service charges, manpower (Field Engineer) remunerations etc. for meeting the post take over expenses related to NDMS VSAT Pilot Project of NDMA as per the terms of MoU agreement signed between Govt. of Assam & NDMA

narrative: SEC accorded approval for extending AMC for 100 Inflatable Rubber Boats procured in 2015 till January 2020. SEC further directed ASDMA to examine the feasibility for further AMC of these Boats depending upon its physical conditions beyond January 2020 i.e. on completion of five years’ service of the Boats. SEC approved the proposal for phase wise training of the nominated stakeholders like School Focal Point Teachers (SFPT), Student Peer Groups, etc. on School Safety matters and rolling out of "Child Death Reporting Format" and related SOP in the districts.
